cc:Work.dc:title: Held-out DCI-C across all datasets
cc:Work.dc:description: Dataset rows and method columns follow the compact comparison layout of Table 1 in the SSAE paper. Values are means ± population standard deviations across training seeds. Gemma and Pythia occupy separate tables and are never pooled; an em dash denotes an unavailable cell.
